name: Page preview
description: Point at a [[link]] for a moment to see that note in a popover, scrollable, its links clickable: in notes, dashboards, the Links panel and search. While you're editing, hold ⌘. Computers only.

trigger.label: Show a preview
trigger.description: auto needs ⌘ held only while editing a note, hover never, mod (⌘ held) always

delay.label: Delay
delay.description: how long the pointer rests on a link first, in ms
